gloss: essential item; must-have item; indispensable thing to carry

definitions.gloss: essential item; must-have item; indispensable thing to carry

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}の{必携品|ひっけいひん}リスト。
{折|お}りたたみ{傘|かさ}は{梅雨|つゆ}の{時期|じき}の{必携品|ひっけいひん}だ。
examples.english: A folding umbrella is an essential item during the rainy season.

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}{旅行|りょこう}の{必携品|ひっけいひん}として、パスポートのコピーや{常備薬|じょうびやく}を{忘|わす}れないようにしましょう。
examples.english: As essentials for overseas travel, make sure not to forget copies of your passport and your regular medications.

notes:
Composed of {必携|ひっけい} (must-carry, indispensable) + {品|ひん} (item, goods). Often used in travel guides, packing lists, and product recommendations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旅行|りょこう}の{必携品|ひっけいひん}: travel essentials
- {登山|とざん}の{必携品|ひっけいひん}: essential mountaineering gear
- {冬|ふゆ}の{必携品|ひっけいひん}: winter must-haves
- {必携品|ひっけいひん}リスト: essentials list

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {必需品|ひつじゅひん}: necessities, daily essentials — things needed for living, not necessarily portable
- {持|も}ち{物|もの}: belongings, things to bring — neutral term without the "essential" nuance
- {携行品|けいこうひん}: items carried on one's person — formal, often used in official or insurance contexts
